plugin_desc.message: HiProxy - Proxy manager extension for security research

pop_no_configs.message: No profiles yet. Add one in Options first.

profiles_empty.message: No profiles yet. Click the button above to add one.

profiles_reset_confirm.message: Reset all settings? Your profiles, auto switch rules and PAC script will be cleared.

profiles_err_port_invalid.message: Port must be an integer between 1 and 65535

profiles_err_summary.message: $MSG$ row(s) failed validation (marked red). Fix them before saving.

detail_bypass_title.message: Hosts that bypass the proxy (one per line, wildcards supported, see Wildcard Docs)

detail_auth_title.message: Proxy auth (auto-filled for HTTP/HTTPS; SOCKS5 auth requires HiLocalProxy due to Chrome limitation)

auto_desc.message: Auto Switch: choose a proxy per domain. Rules are matched in order, first match wins. Enable it from the popup or by switching mode to Auto Switch.

auto_hint.message: Changes apply instantly, no save needed

auto_empty.message: No rules yet. Added rules will route matched domains automatically.

auto_enable_hint.message: Tip: *.example.com matches example.com and all its subdomains.

pac_desc.message: PAC Script mode: take full control with a custom PAC script. The entry function must be FindProxyForURL(url, host).

pac_invalid_warn.message: Missing FindProxyForURL entry function. This script will be ignored when enabled (fallback to direct).

pac_err_non_ascii.message: PAC script must contain ASCII characters only (Chrome limitation): remove non-ASCII characters such as Chinese comments before saving.

io_desc.message: Export your settings for backup or sharing. Import supports the new format and auto-upgrades legacy 3.x backup files.

io_err_not_json.message: File content is not valid JSON

io_import_confirm.message: Import $MSG1$ profile(s) and $MSG2$ auto switch rule(s), replacing all current settings. Continue?

io_reset_confirm.message: Restore factory default config? All custom settings will be overwritten.

others_use_last_hint.message: Automatically use the last active proxy every time the browser starts

others_badge_hint.message: Display a text badge (AUTO / PAC / SYS) on the toolbar icon

others_lang_browser_hint.message: Used when UI language is set to "Follow browser language"

others_lang_hint.message: Applies instantly to the options page, popup and toolbar tooltip
